primary.title: Replace the fictional expense-tracker seed message in the Ask chat log
primary.description: The Ask panel opens with a hardcoded exchange about JWT auth middleware and an expense-tracker service (index.html:131-134). This fiction persists even after liveAnswers loads, because the seed message is static HTML that loadOutputs() never touches. A new developer reading the dashboard gets a misleading first impression of what the Q&A agent actually knows. The fix is to replace the hardcoded .msg.user / .msg.bot pair with a real exchange drawn from qa-context.json's knownAnswers — for example, the 'How does the dashboard load real data?' answer. This is a two-part change: update the static HTML seed (lines 131-134) and add a short post-load step in loadOutputs() to optionally replace it with the first knownAnswer when qa-context.json is ready. Touches only index.html.
